name: s04_morphomechanics
description: Multicellularity S04 (morphomechanics). A clonal cell cluster grows and divides on the Rust CPM engine; the adhesion knob sets homotypic contact energy. Strong adhesion keeps the cluster one cohesive body; weak adhesion lets growth fracture it into propagules. Emits n_propagules and largest_cluster_fraction.

adhesion.description: cell-cell adhesion in [0,1]; higher = lower homotypic J = cohesive

grow_rate.description: target-volume growth per update per cell

divide_threshold.description: volume at which a cell divides

seed.description: Potts RNG seed (vary for replicate runs)
